entities.title: Merging to main deploys the game
entities.summary: The owner tests, builds and uploads the game from their own machine with npm run deploy.
steps: npm test (the Worker), npm run test:godot (maps and the message layer)
npm run build: Godot 4.7.2 web export, the engine split in parts, boot.js
entities.purpose: The game players reach at icelander.net/games/retro/double-cross/.
entities.deployedBy: The owner, from their own machine: `npm run deploy` in games/double-cross, with wrangler signed in to the icelander.net account. Nothing deploys from GitHub (the Deploy workflow was removed on 2026-11-23).
entities.rollback: No rollback is recorded: check out the previous commit and run `npm run deploy` again, or roll back the Worker's version in Cloudflare's dashboard. There is no database to undo.
